question: Should OpenClaw core permanently reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root despite the documented plugin-owned root-command contract?
rationale: Delegating to the existing implementation is mechanically sound, but only maintainers can decide whether this ergonomic alias outweighs the upgrade compatibility cost for plugins that already register `auth`.

options.title: Keep the models namespace
options.body: Remove the top-level alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single canonical, plugin-safe command.

options.title: Reserve the auth root
options.body: Explicitly approve core ownership, define compatibility behavior for existing plugin roots, and require upgrade plus live collision proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep the models namespace
recommendation.body: Remove the top-level alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single canonical, plugin-safe command.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to recent plugin CLI and registry contract work.
